finding: The glossary lists tag under Avoid for ID Prefix. why_this_severity: The reader can tell from the context that tag means the ID prefix of a finding (no to fails_purpose); the glossary tells the reader to avoid the word, so the reader stops to check whether a second concept exists (raises_cost).
